parameters.name: ContentEncoding
parameters.description:
The encoding format for the `CommandContent` and `Output` fields in the response. Valid values:

- PlainText: Returns the original script content and output.

- Base64: Returns the Base64-encoded script content and output.

The default value is Base64.

parameters.name: LimitBytes
parameters.description: The maximum size of the log in bytes. The value must be between 1 and 1,048,576 (1 MB).

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The time in UTC, formatted according to RFC 3339.
